hero.subtext: Custom websites and business systems engineered end to end, for companies that need something built around how they actually operate.

platformsIntro.title: A website is a brochure. A platform is infrastructure.

contrast.oldBody: A handful of static screens, dropped onto a template, with no real connection between the front end and how the business actually runs day to day.
contrast.newBody: A site or a full multi-portal platform, engineered around the specific business — admin, staff, and customer experiences that actually run the operation, not just describe it.

cards.title: Custom Platforms
cards.body: Multi-portal systems — admin, staff, and customer-facing — built on one shared foundation instead of stitched-together tools.

cards.title: Business Automation
cards.body: Workflows, request handling, and day-to-day operations wired directly into the platform, so less runs on manual effort.

cards.title: Ongoing Management
cards.body: Updates, fixes, and changes handled directly, for a site or platform that's already live and in use.
